meta.name: xhs-login
meta.description:
管理小红书登录状态：检查是否已登录、二维码扫码登录、重置登录切换账号。
当用户提到登录、扫码、账号、切换账号、退出登录、登录状态检查，或其他 skill 报告"未登录"需要先登录时使用。

copy.tagline: 管理小红书登录状态，支持扫码和切换账号
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要登录不同小红书账号或处理登录失效
copy.tagline_en: Manage Xiaohongshu login status with QR code and account switching
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to log into different Xiaohongshu accounts or handle expired sessions

howto.what: 装上后，Claude可以检查小红书登录状态、生成二维码供用户扫码登录、以及清除登录状态以切换账号。
howto.when: 当用户提到“登录”“扫码”“切换账号”等关键词，或其它功能提示未登录需要先登录时触发。

say.text: 检查一下我小红书登录状态
say.note: Claude会调用检查接口并返回当前账号信息。
Claude会生成二维码图片供你使用App扫描。
Claude会先确认清除当前登录状态，然后引导重新扫码。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can check Xiaohongshu login status, generate a QR code for the user to scan and log in, and clear login state to switch accounts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions keywords like "login", "scan QR code", "switch account", or when another skill reports "not logged in" and needs login first.

say_en.note: Claude calls the check endpoint and returns current account info.

say_en.text: Help me log in to Xiaohongshu by scanning.
say_en.note: Claude generates a QR code image for you to scan with the app.
Claude confirms, clears login state, then guides you to scan again.
